title: Plant Breeding
description: Keep the best plants of each harvest, sow only their seed, and the crop shifts a little each generation: by the heritability of the trait times how far from the average the chosen parents were. Keep too few, though, and the line inbreeds and weakens. Unlocks the Breeding Bench and Engineered Seeds.

puzzle.goal: Choose parents that are, on average, S above the population's mean. Only the heritable share of that difference is passed on: the breeder's equation. Write R, how far the next generation's mean moves.
puzzle.name: The breeder's equation
puzzle.ask: Find R in kg/plot for a wheat line: h = @{h}, S = @{S} kg/plot.
puzzle.method: Offspring resemble their parents only as far as the genes explain the parents' difference: the regression slope h².
